name: Hiragana Road Fighter: Remastered Edition v1.0.5
changelog: Hiragana Road Fighter: Remastered Edition v1.0.5! Fixes roadside object positioning across all 11 stages (trees, boulders, palms, buildings, magma vents, ice crystals, sakura trees, lanterns, cacti, mesas, and grandstands). Roadside scenery is now curvature-aware and strictly clamped outside the road asphalt and curbs even during the sharpest curves.
